name: truth-forge
description: Evidence-driven delivery pipeline: brainstorm, plan, harden, implement, validate, and audit with fresh-evidence gates and no-mock discipline. Consolidates functional validation, full functional audit, validation planning, plan hardening, prompt engineering and rating, meta-prompt pipelines, visual inspection, UI experience audit, brainstorming, and structured implementation workflows — plus per-stack real-system testing (pytest/Go/C++/Django/Spring/FastAPI/Playwright), iOS simulator validation with evidence gates, root-cause debugging, production-readiness audits, and red-team/eval workflows — into one coherent plugin.
